summary: Explore Olympia Ceramica’s rimless soft-square masterpiece, its space-saving versatility, and how it seamlessly integrates with Studio Bagno’s Soft Square Collection. Perfect for architects and homeowners alike, this is bathroom sophistication, redefined.
title: Soft Square, Sophisticated: Meet Synthesis Eco
bodyHtml:
Synthesis Eco Wall Faced Pan

Soft Square Silhouette, Timeless Appeal

Designed to mirror the trademark curves of our Nur collection, The Nur Bath is the ultimate hero piece for your space, marked by a sophisticated ‘floating’ effect thanks to its sensuous curves above a subtle underskirt.

Available in both gloss white and semi-gloss white, the Nur bath is simply the epitome of refined design through reduced details.


Synthesis Eco Rimless Back to Wall Suite - 360 x 620 x 870 mm

Crafted in Italy by Olympia Ceramica

Born from a centuries old tradition of ceramic expertise, Synthesis Eco is proudly made by Olympia Ceramica, where tradition meets cutting-edge flushing technology.

Every piece reflects Italian craftsmanship, ensuring durability, performance, water efficiency (WELS 4 Star Rated) and timeless appeal.


Synthesis Eco Floor Mount Pan - 360 x 520 x 420 mm

Crafted for Comfort & Performance

Pair Synthesis Eco with our Soft Square Collection to create a harmonious bathroom narrative across your bathroom fixtures. The Soft Square Collection blends effortlessly, offering a unified aesthetic that elevates your entire space.

Synthesis Eco is also available in a range of colours and hues including Matte White & Matte Black.

CleanMax Technology

Synthesis is designed with hygiene at its core. Its rimless style eliminates hidden crevices where bacteria can thrive, ensuring a cleaner, more sanitary bowl.

The one-touch quick-release seat makes thorough cleaning effortless, while the CleanMax anti-bacterial glaze prevents dirt and bacteria build-up, keeping your toilet fresh and hygienic for the lifetime of the product.

Versatile in Every Space

With its innovative short projection, Synthesis Eco fits flawlessly in both compact and spacious bathrooms—without compromising seating comfort or flush efficiency.

Select from back-to-wall suite, floor-mount, or wall-hung variations to suit your bathroom layout. Whether you’re renovating or building new, Synthesis Eco adapts to your vision.
